system_overview: This is a utility module providing helper operators for organizing nodes into ring topologies. It defines predicates and constructors for simple cycles (ring structures) over finite sets of nodes, supporting the ring-based termination detection algorithms in this folder.
actors_and_components: The module provides two main operators: one that checks whether a given function defines a simple cycle over a set (a permutation where iterating the function visits every element exactly once), and one that constructs such a simple cycle from a given finite set. The simple cycle constructor converts the set to a sequence and chains elements together.
additional_assumptions: The module extends Integers, Sequences, FiniteSets, TLC, Functions, and SequencesExt standard and community modules. Two variants of the cycle predicate are provided: a non-recursive version compatible with PlusPy (a TLA+ interpreter for Python) and a recursive version that is orders of magnitude faster when evaluated by TLC.
